title: Multiband Combiner
text: Frequency-shift and combine signals, 1 input, 1 output, {Frequency offsets (Hz)} sets Frequency offsets [0; {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the input signal sample, {Rate options} sets the options for processing rate Enforce single-rate, {Output sample rate options} sets the options for output sample rate, {Output sample rate (Hz)} sets the output signal sample and {Output delay (samples)} sets the output delay Read-only. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: Input signals N samp -by- N chan matrix

params.name: Input sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Input signal sample rate 1e6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Frequency offsets (Hz)
params.values: Frequency offsets [0 1e6] (default) | scalar | 1-by- N chan vector

params.name: Rate options
params.values: Options for processing rate Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing

params.name: Output sample rate options
params.values: Options for output sample rate Auto (default) | Specify via property

params.name: Output sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Output signal sample rate 3e6 (default) | positive scalar
